Title: Public Preview: Customer Managed Failover for ADLS Gen2

Body.Content:
As Azure Storage strives to provide you with effective disaster recovery offerings we are now supporting customer-managed failover for ADLS Gen2 accounts. Whether you are performing disaster recovery testing or facing a true disaster on your primary endpoint you can now initiate a failover from your primary endpoint to your secondary endpoint on ADLS Gen2 accounts. 

For more details and regional availability information visit: Disaster recovery and storage account failover - Azure Storage | Microsoft Learn
